pattern: \bwhich buys most\b|\bthe two companies that buy (?:most )?conventional loans\b
struck: Fannie Mae, one of the two companies that buy conventional loans, will not buy a loan in a building run like a hotel.
use: Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac, the two companies Congress created to buy mortgages from lenders, will not buy a loan in a building run like a hotel.

struck: A building whose name contains the word resort is ineligible at Fannie Mae.
use: Fannie Mae will not take a building whose name contains hotel, motel or resort, unless the word only refers to the building's past use.

struck: Freddie Mac will not buy a loan in any building that allows short-term rentals.
use: Freddie Mac will not buy a loan in a condo hotel, and it reads the building's papers and services to decide what is one.

struck: An FHA borrower signs a contract with HUD not to rent the home for less than 30 days.
use: FHA will not insure a loan on a condotel, and it will not approve a condo building that is a condo hotel or has a required rental pool.

pattern: \b(?:2|two) of (?:the )?29\b|\bnone of the other 27\b|\bno FHA or VA\b
struck: Two of the 29 resort buildings in our directory have an accepted VA record; none of the other 27 does.
use: At least 6 of the 47 buildings in our directory have an accepted VA record: Beach Cove Resort, the Renaissance Tower at Myrtle Beach Resort, Monterey Bay Suites, Sands Ocean Club, Crescent Shores and Mar Vista Grande.

pattern: \babout (?:1|one) in (?:5|five)\b[^.]{0,120}\b(?:under|smaller than|less than|do not)\b|\b(?:pass|meet)\w* (?:a |the )?(?:condotel lender's )?size test\b
struck: Most rental-program condos pass a condotel lender's size test. About 1 in 5 do not.
use: More than 3 in 4 rental-program condos for sale are 500 square feet or more. More than 1 in 5 are smaller.

struck: 22 of the 47 oceanfront buildings in our directory go by a name with Resort or a hotel brand in it.
use: 23 of the 47 oceanfront buildings in our directory go by a name with Resort or a hotel brand in it.

struck: About 800 units changed hands by recorded deed in the 47 directory buildings in a year, out of about 11,800 units.
use: About 780 units sold one at a time by recorded deed in a year, in the 43 directory buildings with a county count, out of about 11,500 units.

struck: SeaWatch was named one of the best hotels in South Carolina.
use: SeaWatch calls itself one of the best hotels in South Carolina.

struck: Kingston Resorts runs rental programs beside a Hilton and an Embassy Suites.
use: Kingston Resorts' own site books its condos and villas alongside rooms at the Embassy Suites and the Hilton.

pattern: \bmore down than (?:a |on a )?(?:regular|normal|standard|ordinary) condo\b|\bsubstantially larger down payment\b
struck: Plan on more down than a regular condo loan.
use: A DSCR loan on a condotel usually takes more down than a DSCR loan on other homes.

pattern: \b(?:same|normal|standard) (?:lender )?fees?\b|\bfees? (?:will|do) not (?:rise|go up|have to be inflated)\b|\bBrickWood\b[^.]{0,40}\bfinances\b|\bscarcity as a pricing strategy\b
struck: BrickWood Mortgage charges the same lender fees on a condotel file as on any other loan it originates.
use: Our affiliated lender, BrickWood Mortgage, a separate company, arranges condotel and non-warrantable loans through wholesale lenders that accept these buildings.
